pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   C. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.

5. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   B. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   B. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

9. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   D. Treat Insurance as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

11. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.

12. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

7. B — Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. C — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. B — Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A — Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A — Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. C — Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of Business Ownership; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Networking in Business; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Entrepreneurship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Marketing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
